text:
Maya (Product): dropped a quick question on the new spend-card variant in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc — primary goal: make token breakdown readable at glance while keeping rows dense.
Tess (Design Ops): I made two small mocks: inline mini-pills next to the sparkline, and an expandable detail row. Desktop favors pills, mobile favors expand.
Sam (PM): growth wants visible numbers without extra clicks. inline pills are better for conversion tests.
Leo (Eng): perf note: thousands of DOM pills will hurt paint on low-end browsers. solution: send 3-value aggregated numbers from backend and render as plain text/SVG, not separate DOM nodes per token slice.
Anya (A11y): please avoid hover-only reveals. pills must be reachable via keyboard and announced by screen readers. recommend a single aria-label summarizing the pill group.
Maya (Product): agreed. decision for now: desktop = inline pills visible, mobile = expand on tap, keyboard focus shows pills. update copy: "Estimated monthly spend" -> "Monthly cost estimate" across the card.
John (Revenue): CSV/export reminder: visible values should map to columns. suggested headers: transaction_id,account_id,project_id,token_category,tokens,cost_usd,date
Sam (PM): can we add a tiny tooltip on pill hover with exact counts and link to invoice? lazy-init tooltip to avoid perf hit.
Leo (Eng): fine if tooltip is DOM-based and lazy-loaded; we'll reuse aggregated payload. also will run perf checks on a set of low-end devices after Tess uploads mobile mock.
Anya (A11y): tooltip must use role="tooltip" and be focus-triggerable. also check contrast for pill text in dark mode (need 4.5:1).
Tess (Design Ops): uploading final mocks and contrast token notes now. I'll annotate the pill treatment and mobile flow.
Maya (Product): thanks — I'll update Figma and leave comments for Eng/A11y. will post a short Loom with final decisions once perf pass is complete. :white_check_mark:
